cases.task: Several product pages drift in spacing, components and vocabulary, and the repository lacks reliable product/design context.
required_outcomes: derive product/design context from canonical evidence after filtering legacy drift
record durable context without inventing a rebrand
forbidden_outcomes: invent a brand identity and claim it was derived from the repo

cases.task: Correct a spelling typo in an unrelated documentation sentence.
required_outcomes: do not invoke this specialized workflow for a trivial unrelated edit
forbidden_outcomes: trigger design-context-bootstrap without a task-relevant reason
